extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, regulated entities, researchers, and stakeholders searching Federal Register greenhouse gas rulemaking and notice-and-comment documents
extracted.subtask_description: A search-results listing of Federal Register documents matching the term 'greenhouse gas', aggregating notices, proposed rules, final rules, and related materials; useful for locating actions open for public comment, hearings, and associated dockets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment deadline and comment period extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received on or before [date]; agencies may extend the public comment period (e.g., 'Comments must be received on or before September 22, 2025.'; 'EPA is extending the comment period for this proposed rule.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check each document's DATES section for the deadline. Agencies may publish separate notices extending comment periods; when an extension is published, submit by the new deadline. Examples on the page include explicit extensions and new deadlines for specified proposed rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket identification and submission instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments should be identified by the docket number and may be submitted according to addresses listed in the document (e.g., 'You may send your comments, identified by Docket ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the ADDRESSES instructions in each Federal Register document: include the docket identifier, use the specified submission method(s) (e.g., regulations.gov, mail, email), and follow any formatting or identification requirements explained in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public hearing participation and testimony procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies may hold public hearings (including virtual hearings) with sign-up procedures and scheduled sessions (e.g., 'EPA will hold a virtual public hearing ... An additional session will be held ... to accommodate the number of testifiers that sign up to testify.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attend or register per the notice's instructions, be aware that agencies may add sessions if sign-ups exceed capacity, and follow any time/format limits or procedural rules published in the hearing notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted solicitation of input from particular stakeholder groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies often request input 'especially from interested individuals and entities, such as industry, academia, research laboratories, government agencies, and other stakeholders.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you represent or work in an identified stakeholder group, tailor comments to bring relevant expertise, data, or perspectives requested by the agency; identify your affiliation when submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for recommendations to improve technical reports or inventories
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies solicit recommendations to improve the overall quality of reports (e.g., 'EPA requests recommendations for improving the overall quality of the inventory report to be finalized ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific, evidence-based suggestions on methodology, data sources, uncertainty treatment, sectoral estimates, or presentation; reference sectoral chapters when they are posted and tie recommendations to documented methodologies (e.g., IPCC/UNFCCC-aligned approaches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology submission requirement for credit or exemption applications
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicants seek credits or regulatory relief (e.g., off-cycle CO2 credits), they 'must provide EPA with a proposed methodology for determining the real-world off-cycle benefit' and the methodology is made available for public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clear, reproducible methodology, supporting data, and justification for real-world benefits; expect the methodology to be posted for public review and comment and to be evaluated against regulatory criteria and test-procedure limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open-ended solicitation for comments on a proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Some notices explicitly invite comments on 'any aspects of this proposal' (e.g., DOE proposing to rescind reporting requirements: 'DOE seeks all comments on any aspects of this proposal').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an agency invites broad feedback, commenters may address legal, technical, procedural, economic, and policy implications; organize comments clearly and support assertions with data, citations, and analysis where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope clarity for limited-rule changes (what the action does and does not change)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices sometimes clarify that a final rule only changes a specific element (e.g., 'This final rule changes only the reporting deadline ... This rule does not change the reporting deadline for future years, and it does not change the requirements for what regulated entities must report.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When commenting, focus on the aspects the agency is actually amending; if you wish to address other aspects, check whether the agency indicates those will be addressed in separate actions and consider submitting separate, targeted comments if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Waiver and contract-specific determination criteria for disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: In acquisition/regulatory contexts, disclosure requirements may include waiver provisions (e.g., 'A waiver is permitted on a contract-by-contract basis, provided that the information relating to greenhouse gas emissions is directly related to the performance of the contract.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proposing or responding to contract clauses, document why disclosure is or is not necessary to verify performance; understand and comment on the proposed waiver conditions and how they would operate in practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and content suggestions for environmental impact statements (EIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: When agencies prepare EISs they identify topics for analysis and public comment such as 'impacts of greenhouse gas emissions (to include the social cost of carbon) and other common impacts.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide data, modeling approaches, or references regarding GHG emissions, climate impacts, and social cost estimates; comment on appropriate functional units, time horizons, baseline scenarios, and analytical methods to include in the EIS.
